# ScaleAndFit (scaleandfit.com)

ScaleAndFit is a 100% client-side, zero-tracking utility platform housing four precision studio suites:

- /visual-sizer/ — Visual TV/monitor/mattress scale overlays & airline carry-on sizer checks
- /printable-paper/ — Client-side vector PDF dot-grid, graph, Cornell notes, holiday calendars & Avery labels
- /size-converter/ — Millimeter Mondopoint brand shoe matrix & credit-card calibrated ring sizer
- /passport-photo/ — Local biometric passport/visa photo cropper & 300-DPI 4x6 print sheet generator

All math, PDF synthesis, and image cropping execute strictly on the user's device.
